title: Umme kulsoom qwaahar e zainab
body:
Umme kulsoom qwaahar e zainab
Zindagi bhar sahi tu ranj o ta'ab
Guzre rone me tere roz o shab
Margayi gham utha ke haye ghazab
<<MINI>>
Ab ali o batool rote hai
Peet kar sar rasool rote hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Bhai ko roz o shab jo roti thi
Muh ko ashkou se apne dhoti thi
Gham se fursat jise na hoti thi
Jaan ro ro ke apni khoti thi
<<MINI>>
Wo jaha'n se guzar gayi hai hai
Umme kulsoom margayi hai hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Yaad aate hai tere gham bibi
Wo aseeri wo qaid ki saqti
Tujh pe yu rash ghamo alam ki thi
Uf wo rudaad be ridaayi ki
<<MINI>>
Tujhko jab se ghame hussain mila
Ek pal bhi tujhe na chain mila
<<DIVIDER>>
Qaid se chut ke jab watan aayi
Sath bhai ka apne gham laayi
Zabt karne na paayi dukh paayi
Dekha jis dam madina chillayi
<<MINI>>
Gham pe gham hum utha ke aaye hai
Saare ghar ko luta ke aaye hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Aye madine hame qubool na kar
Kat gaya tegh se hussain ka sar
Chin gayi thi sarou se bhi chadar
Wapas aate hai phir ke hum dar dar
<<MINI>>
Marte dam tak ye gham uthaana hai
Aisa aana bhi koi aana hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Ham museebat utha ke aaye hai
Qaid qaane me jaake aaye hai
Bhai bete gawaa ke aaye hai
Qabr sheh ki banake aaye hai
<<MINI>>
Sath bete hai aur na waali hai
Godiya bibiyo ki qaali hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Bain tu ne kiye jo zaar o qataar
Gham se dil hogaye sabhi ke figaar
Daagh the tere ek dil pe hazaar
Kitni pur dard thi wo teri pukaar
<<MINI>>
Qoo'n rulata hai marsiya tera
Gham se dil choor choor tha tera
<<DIVIDER>>
Haye kaisi ulat gayi taqdeer
Gayi darbaar me tu ho ke aseer
Aaqri saans tak rahi dilgeer
Umme kulsoom qaahare shabbir
<<MINI>>
Karbala jab bhi yaad aati hai
Yaad hum ko teri rulaati hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Sare baazaar sar khule jaana
Durre zalim ke pusht par khana
Yaad abbas ko wo farmana
Tera darbaare sham me jaana
<<MINI>>
Qatm har ek jafa huwi tujh par
Zulm ki inteha huwi tujh par
